title: scijigsaw: evidence-typed probabilistic reasoning and hypothesis navigation for protein-complex assembly
description:
Scientific Jigsaw keeps contacts, temporal prerequisites, exclusions, observed subcomplexes, alternative structural models and contextual weights distinct while reasoning over the complete protein-complex assembly-mechanism space. Exact dynamic programmes enumerate seed-anchored histories or general merger trees and classify a queried intermediate as impossible, optional or necessary; strictly positive evidence weights then redistribute probability among already-admissible mechanisms, yielding exact branch probabilities and an effective number of competing mechanisms without converting soft evidence into hard possibility.

This release adds the evidence-weighted inference layer, the probabilistic assembly tree, the TEST/WHY/COMPARE/UPDATE hypothesis navigator (command-line session and self-contained browser view), the cryo-EM observation-set analysis, and counterfactual model comparison, together with complete biological encodings, the AlphaFold 3 eIF3 model ensemble and scripts reproducing every number and figure in the manuscript. Software accompanying Liò & Liò, PLOS (2026, submitted).
